en.headline: Asian Gaelic Games mark 30th anniversary at Tseung Kwan O training centre
en.dek: More than 700 athletes from across Asia and Ireland are competing in Gaelic football, hurling and camogie this weekend at the Jockey Club HKFA Football Training Centre.
body: The Asian Gaelic Games opened on Saturday at the Jockey Club HKFA Football Training Centre in Tseung Kwan O, marking the 30th anniversary of the annual tournament.

More than 700 amateur athletes from Ireland and across the region are taking part in group-stage matches of Gaelic football, hurling and camogie on Saturday, with knockout stages and finals scheduled for Sunday. The event is hosted by Hong Kong GAA.

Organisers said the tournament reflects growth in Irish sports among expatriate and local communities in Asia. Matches run from morning into the evening on both days, with youth activities and a food village also on site.

zh.headline: 亞洲蓋爾克運動會於將軍澳訓練中心迎來30周年
zh.dek: 逾700名來自亞洲及愛爾蘭的運動員週末於將軍澳賽馬會足球訓練中心參與蓋爾克足球、曲棍球及女子曲棍球比賽。
body: 亞洲蓋爾克運動會周六在將軍澳賽馬會足球訓練中心開幕，迎來這項年度賽事的30周年。
逾700名來自愛爾蘭及亞洲各地的業餘運動員周六參與蓋爾克足球、曲棍球及女子曲棍球的小組賽，周日則進行淘汰賽及決賽。賽事由香港蓋爾克運動協會主辦。
組辦方表示，賽事反映愛爾蘭運動在亞洲外籍社群及本地社區的發展。比賽兩天由早晨進行至傍晚，場內亦有青少年活動及食物村。
